component.name: NetStacks
component.summary: AI-powered SSH terminal for network engineers

description.p: NetStacks is a terminal for network engineers: SSH, Telnet and SFTP sessions to routers, switches, firewalls and servers, with an AI assistant that can read what is on screen and help troubleshoot.

ul.li: Multi-session SSH and Telnet with tabs and saved profiles
SFTP file transfer and an editor for remote files
An encrypted credential vault behind a master password
An AI assistant that works with your own provider and model
SNMP polling and network topology from LLDP and CDP
Paste hygiene and clipboard history tuned for device CLIs
